verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's docs explicitly describe a dashboard import tool for existing internet-accessible MySQL/MariaDB databases with 'no downtime' (planetscale-docs-13, planetscale-docs-21), giving a documented migration path. Community evidence corroborates smooth production migrations (e.g., Metal migration over the weekend with major improvements), though one user notes friction migrating from Heroku due to logical replication restrictions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the MySQL/MariaDB import tool (vs. Postgres/Metal migrations), and no mention of Postgres import path with equivalent zero-downtime guarantee.
